first.rationale: I intend to test shortening onboarding because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that reducing onboarding friction improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. I will verify the onboarding result and compare it with the promotional-pricing evidence before committing, since pricing may recover price-sensitive SMB acquisition but could create downstream qualified-revenue or sustainability risk. The test should be guarded with downstream qualification and revenue-quality checks.
